evidence.inspection: Viewed full image at native scale.

findings: Adult narrow traveler silhouette with long planted legs, split patched blue-gray coat, copper tablet and caged coal staff; no oversized head or wizard hat.
Preparation, extended tablet release, and recovery are visible across the eight poses; arms and carried equipment are individually keyed rather than whole-body translations.

v2 increases physical key-light energy from 150 to 300 and uses lighter authored material albedos before palette reduction. Coat/face/equipment remain visible on peat/linen/olive. Hair/nose/brow now inherit the head turn.

Declared ground pivot is fixed at (32,56); perspective toes occupy the same bottom row 58 throughout. Deliberate extended arm changes left bounds from x19 to x13; body is not re-centered or cropped per frame.
This is one southeast cast pilot, not a finished 24-culture character kit, idle/walk set, or all-facing animation.
limitations: Studio source images inspected; preview.html temporal playback not browser-tested by this reviewer.
